data.name: Anayath
data.gender_notes: Anayath is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anayath is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ananta' meaning 'endless'. The prefix 'Ana-' indicates 'sky' or 'heaven', making Anayath the 'Lord of the Sky' or 'Lord of the Heavens'. The name Anayath carries the meaning “Lord of the Sky” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anayath usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the infinite, boundless nature of the universe and the divine power that governs it.
data.etymology: Anayath belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anayath total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
